findings.title: 9/16 old-save Reader-confirmed metric source assignments lack materialized columns or values
findings.independent_observation: Fixed v24 team_game_boxes has 2124 rows but fg_attempted, three_attempted, three_made, turnovers, steals, offensive_rebounds, defensive_rebounds all have non_null_rows=0 (7 claimed metrics). Opponent FGA and opponent 3PA 'team_game_boxes:opponent ...' labels have no corresponding opponent_* column in team_game_boxes (2 claimed metrics); other side's value may require a validated team/opponent join, but is not direct proven Reader output. M4 labels all 9 'WORLDDATA_READER_CONFIRMED_ON_OLD_SAVE'.
findings.risk: D-series may skip native game-stat discovery or assume old team box Reader can serve these metrics immediately.
findings.required_fix: Evaluate actual field-level non-null/materialized status, native source type, measured/save context, source provenance, and join/derivation separately. Downgrade 7 all-NULL to SCHEMA_PRESENT_DATA_NOT_OBSERVED and 2 opponent fields to NATIVE_SOURCE_OR_JOIN_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED (or produce exact validated old-save query/reader receipt). Propagate to M3/verification count. Do not infer game-native absence.

findings.title: PLAYER_PTS mislabeled as directly native-calculated old Reader source though stored value is derived by formula
findings.independent_observation: WorldData v24 player_game_boxes.points: 26400/26400 non-null, source_declaration='DERIVED_WITH_FORMULA: 2*fg_made+three_made+ft_made; AG01D fixture replay'. Stage02 marks PLAYER_PTS NATIVE_BOX_OR_PLAYER_SOURCE_ON_OLD_SAVE and WORLDDATA_READER_CONFIRMED_ON_OLD_SAVE, without distinguishing this derived stored number from genuine game-computed native points.
findings.risk: Violation of Human Native-computed-first evidence semantics; derived value may be useful, but provenance and precision not Native proof.
findings.required_fix: Represent existing derived points as existing DERIVED_OBSERVATION/ESTIMATED_PROXY (not stage02-created calculator); independently discover native game-computed player points for same source/grain, allow native-to-derived reconciliation only after provenance. Do not delete legacy value or imply game itself lacks PTS.

findings.title: 15 graph OBSERVABLE_METRIC bundle nodes have no typed mapping to 38 metric_requirement IDs
findings.independent_observation: Graph uses MET_FGA, MET_PACE, MET_TOUCH, MET_DEF3 etc. None of 15 OBSERVABLE_METRIC nodes has metric_requirement_ids property; none matches exactly a metric_requirements[].metric_id such as PLAYER_FGA/TEAM_FGA, TEAM_PACE_NATIVE, MET_TOUCHES_NATIVE. Field-based action_behavior_metric_requirements partly overlaps graph but has no graph edge_id/node join. MET_ORATING and MET_ACTION are isolated. Structural node existence and 50-edge counts do not establish full Action->Behavior->native metric queryability.
findings.risk: Future D1 Action→Information→Field chain cannot determine which of multiple granular native metrics each graph outcome requires; trace can silently stop at a bundle.
findings.required_fix: Add explicit many-to-many mappings from each MET_* graph outcome to approved metric IDs, typed entity/grain and scope; document absent links and unresolved status. Enforce referential+coverage tests and sample traced end-to-end Shot→FGA, Tempo→Pace and HelpDefense→Opponent3PA. Do not invent new proven causal edges.

findings.title: GPT 24 metadata gaps, 3 ledger discrepancies and 15 nonstandard conflict-key cases only summarized globally, not explicitly localizable per affected field
findings.independent_observation: Each of 204 fields has individualized GPT result and valid dossier/ledger pointer; 51 NO_DIRECT_NATIVE_FIELD_IDENTITY_SOURCE labels localize. But known_conflicts per field only include seed vs Gemini alias, blanket open P0 and no causal receipt; none explicitly labels GPT_METADATA_GAP/LEDGER_COUNT_DISCREPANCY/NONSTANDARD_CONFLICT_KEY, despite 24/3/15 summarized in prose. No field IDs for these separate forensic issues were established by this reviewer.
findings.risk: Decision architecture cannot use per-field risk filters for known GPT provenance anomalies; global summary is insufficient to route targeted repair.
findings.required_fix: Provide separate keyed provenance anomalies index sourced from fixed GPT audit, with impacted field IDs or explicit global-only/UNLOCATABLE status; preserve exact source and count discrepancy without inventing affected IDs. Optionally join into each field via field_id.

findings.title: Published M09 verification receipt remains pre-closeout, although final branch was independently confirmed
findings.independent_observation: Receipt check M09 status PASS but verified_source_head 7340552..., commits6, changed_paths6 and final_commit_readback=PENDING_POST_PUBLICATION; actual finalized cf95 HEAD is +8 commits since dispatch and 9 changed Run files. The immutability/cannot self-reference own SHA caveat is understood; this is stale evidence scope, not proof remote publication failed.
findings.risk: Future reviews quoting M09 as final published evidence may confuse a prepublication gate with the independently verified final HEAD.
findings.required_fix: Record separately named postpublication verification evidence with fixed commit and scope or make M09 clearly PRE_PUBLICATION_PASS_FINAL_READBACK_EXTERNAL; never attempt impossible self-referential commit hash.

findings.title: Twelve graph nodes isolated, with possible semantic role ambiguity for rebound/POE relationships
findings.independent_observation: Independent graph traversal found 68 nodes, 50 edges, DAG, 12 isolated nodes: COACH_DEFAULT_007/008/012, WORLD_REG_085/086, CTX_ROSTER/SAVE/PREGAME, CONS_ACE/GAME_STATS, MET_ORATING/ACTION. REBOUND_TRADEOFF action is keyed to COACH_DEFAULT_003=POEOffense3, and graph conjectures offensive rebounding behavior; it is correctly graded HYPOTHESIS but not a verified 'crash glass' setting.
findings.risk: Coverage numbers could imply stronger mechanism completeness than realized, or a semantic hypothesis could be misinterpreted as a specific native rebound control.
findings.required_fix: Declare intentionally isolated nodes as backlog/unknown, add per-node coverage status, and flag rebound POE linkage as provisional semantically unproven; do not add edges simply to eliminate isolation.
